docxport 0.1.1

- Removed legacy file: skill-card.md.
- Updated documentation (CHANGELOG.md, SKILL.md) for clarity and relevance.
- No changes to conversion logic or user-facing behavior.

Initial release: centralized, watermark-free document conversion with strict tool selection and medium mandate.

- Converts Markdown, HWP, DOCX, and RTF to PDF/PNG/HTML/DOCX with priority on LibreOffice for watermark-free output.
- Enforces use of this skill for all supported document conversions—no direct ad-hoc commands allowed.
- Differentiates "Official/external" vs. "Internal/draft" deliverables and picks a conversion tool accordingly (LibreOffice mandatory for official use).
- Documents rigorous fallback logic for conversion tools, clearly marking watermarked or internal-use-only options.
- Prevents silent downgrade to txt extraction for rich-format analysis; defaults to PDF/HTML with preserved layout and media.
- Introduces mandatory user prompts for LibreOffice installation if not found, blocking accidental watermark-leakage on external files.
